error_direction_rationale: Every gap in a declaration raises a flag that mirrors into manual_review_required, the honest no-pinned-fact marker (unpinned_in_cited_sources) itself raises LOCAL_FACT_UNPINNED, and unknown values are refused rather than silently accepted, so uncertainty always surfaces as a finding, never as a clean pass. The only zero-flag outcome is a fully declared matrix whose every cell resolves to a closed-vocabulary chained source or a pinned local fact.
